title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.56: Diagnostic build for the stack-overflow crash during Planned-heavy resolution (Workshop + Da Capo). Adds a recursion guard that logs the offending call stack ([RecursionDiag]) and short-circuits BEFORE the crash, so the game should no longer hard-crash in that spot. No intended gameplay change.
